name: Asa Dodds
role: Early elder sent to the western countries
dateNote: He was an elder by February 1831; section 75 names him in January 1832.
importance: In 1831 he travelled with Orson Pratt from Missouri to Indiana. Section 75 sends him and Calves Wilson to preach in the western countries. Little else is known; by 1835 he had moved to Tennessee.
connections: His companion in section 75 was Calves Wilson.

sources.title: Asa Dodds, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: JSP gives no birth or death dates. It records baptism and ordination by 4 Feb. 1831, the 1831 mission with Orson Pratt, near Fayette, Missouri, by 1833, and Paris, Tennessee, by 1835.
